entries.what: Section 2: Joel's own rewrite of the paragraph on what communal ownership needs (2026-10-01 14:49), with one spelling fix, "leaching" to "leeching" [in the section 2 v3 candidate]
entries.joel: Communal ownership entails folks taking on visible and named stewardship duties. It requires knowing what to do if someone is leaching off the group and how to deal with it. It requires developing healthier forms of relationships. No, taking away the idea of a boss does not make everyone less passive, selfish, steal less, or try to act helpless.
